# Project Setup

You should always make sure to run the test suite before pushing changes to the
main branch. This is really important because it helps catch bugs early.

## Installation

Basically, you just need to install the dependencies. See the docs at
https://example.com/docs for more details.

Run the install command:

```bash
npm install
npm run build
```

## Notes

- Remember to update the changelog
- Make sure to bump the version number
